summary: Enhance your banking skills with our training course on customer outcomes and ethical product pricing. Learn to create value-driven financial solutions today.
lede: Ethical banking product pricing examines how product design and charges affect customer outcomes. The course is for banking professionals involved in products, pricing, governance or customer experience, and applies customer psychology and target-market research to practical decisions. Participants learn to identify unfair pricing and harmful complexity, monitor outcomes using complaints and other signals, and explain and document pricing choices.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence products, pricing, and customer experience across various sectors of the banking industry.
audience: Product development and product governance teams
Compliance, conduct risk, and risk management staff
Relationship managers and customer experience leads
modules: Product Design with the Customer in Mind
Target Market Research and Product Suitability
Managing Conduct Risk in Product and Pricing Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of banking operations and financial product management. Familiarity with regulatory concepts is beneficial but not required.
